# NumberField

A number input with its unit inside the box (BPM, min, %, bars), minus and plus steppers, a stated range and mono digits.

`SongNodes.NumberField` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.NumberField label="…" value={0} onChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.NumberField" label="…" value="{{0}}" on-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (NumberFieldProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | Visible label. |
| `value` * | `number` | Current value. |
| `onChange` * | `(value: number) => void` | Called with a committed, clamped, step-snapped value. |
| `unit` * | `string` | Unit shown inside the box and in aria-valuetext ("BPM", "min", "%"). |
| `min` * | `number` | Minimum allowed. |
| `max` * | `number` | Maximum allowed. |
| `step` | `number` | Step for arrows and steppers; Page Up/Down use 10 steps. Default 1. |
| `help` | `string` | Help text. |
| `error` | `string` | Error message (out of range or not a number). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disabled. |
